name: 司法（鉴定/拍卖/评估）规范

map.📋 司法（鉴定/拍卖/评估）规范: 📋 Judicial Appraisal, Auction and Valuation Standards
map.司法房地产评估合规性检查工具，从鉴定主体资格、评估程序规范、评估标准适用、评估报: A compliance checker for judicial real estate appraisal, scoring four dimensions: appraiser qualification, procedural compliance, standard application and report quality.
map.📖 查看「司法（鉴定/拍卖/评估）规范 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Judicial Appraisal, Auction and Valuation Standards User Guide"
map.司法评估合规评分 = 鉴定主体资格 + 评估师回避 + 委托程序 + 现场勘验: Judicial appraisal compliance score = appraiser qualification + appraiser recusal + engagement procedure + site inspection + valuation method + report standards + valuation date + auction reserve price (0 to 2 points each, 16 in total); 14 or above is compliant, 10-13 broadly compliant, 6-9 partly non-compliant, and below 6 seriously non-compliant with the result inadmissible.
map.1. 评估机构是否具备司法鉴定资质: 1. Does the appraisal firm hold judicial appraisal qualification
map.2. 评估师是否持证且与案件无利害关系: 2. Is the appraiser licensed and free of interest in the case
map.2-持证且无回避情形: 2 - licensed with no ground for recusal
map.4. 现场勘验是否规范完整: 4. Is the site inspection complete and properly conducted
map.6. 评估报告是否规范完整: 6. Is the appraisal report complete and compliant
map.8. 拍卖保留价是否合理: 8. Is the auction reserve price reasonable
map.1-保留价偏低/偏高: 1 - reserve price too low / too high
map.司法评估须由法院委托具有司法鉴定资质的机构进行: Judicial appraisal must be commissioned by the court from a firm holding judicial appraisal qualification
map.评估师与案件当事人有利害关系的应当回避: An appraiser with an interest in a party to the case must recuse
map.评估时点一般为法院委托日或勘验日: The valuation date is usually the date of court engagement or of inspection
map.拍卖保留价一般为评估价的70%-100%: The auction reserve price is usually 70%-100% of the appraised value
map.法院委托评估前自查程序是否合规。: Self-check procedural compliance before a court-commissioned appraisal.
map.当事人异议时对照检查项补充材料。: Where a party objects, work through the checklist to supplement the file.
map.评估机构内部质控按八项打分。: Firms use the eight items for internal quality control scoring.
map.鉴定主体资格、评估师回避、委托程序、现场勘验、评估方法、报告规范、评估时点、拍卖: Appraiser qualification, recusal, engagement procedure, site inspection, method, report standards, valuation date and reserve price each score 0-2, for 16 in total; 14 or above is compliant, and scoring 2 on all eight gives a compliant 16.
map.若评估师应回避未回避、未现场勘验、方法明显不当，合计低于 6 分则严重违规，评估: Failure to recuse, no site inspection or a clearly inappropriate method scoring below 6 in total is serious non-compliance: the result is inadmissible and a fresh appraisal is required.
map.合规评分低会怎样？: What happens if the compliance score is low?
map.低于 10 分视为部分违规需补正，低于 6 分严重违规，对方可申请执行异议或申请: Below 10 counts as partial non-compliance needing correction, below 6 as serious; the other party may file an enforcement objection or seek a fresh appraisal.
map.拍卖保留价算检查项吗？: Is the reserve price part of the check?
map.算，保留价设定是否合理是司法评估合规的重要一环，需与评估值挂钩并留痕。: Yes. Whether the reserve price is reasonable is a key element of judicial appraisal compliance; it must be tied to the appraised value and documented.
